stage: preregistration written BEFORE any lane result; no lane control run and no campaign cell has been executed in this lane

hypothesis.statement: For gamma in {0.75, 1.0, 1.25, 1.4} and every 2x2 Hermitian W(x) >= 0, R[W] = Tr(-d^2/dx^2 - W)_-^gamma / int tr W^(gamma+1/2) <= L1(gamma) (Lean sharpConstant). Upstream claim (another model, 2026-10-05, not in Lean), tested adversarially, not proved.
hypothesis.kill_criterion: VIOLATION_CERTIFIED in any cell with this lane's controls passing (reported as a Tier X candidate, not a discovery, no extrapolation)

decision_rule.VOID: any control in the lane's own controls.json fails (all_pass != true): lane stops, no cell number counts. lt_a_driver.py refuses to start chunks without all_pass.
decision_rule.excess: excess = R_lower_bound / L1 - 1 (R from the frozen instrument; Dirichlet box + Rayleigh-Ritz make it a lower bound up to quadrature)
decision_rule.flag: a restart is flagged if excess > 1e-7; campaign.py then refines it (doubled grid; finite-difference Richardson)
decision_rule.VIOLATION_CERTIFIED: some flagged restart has refined-grid excess > 1e-5 AND finite-difference excess > 5e-6. Additionally the stored .pt parameters are re-evaluated on a third independent grid (L = 32, M = 256, Q = 3200) by lt_a_driver.py recheck, and all three numbers are reported; the third grid is reported but the frozen rule is not altered.
decision_rule.UNDECIDED: a restart flagged and no restart satisfies the CERTIFIED condition (1e-7 < refined excess <= 1e-5, or the two solvers disagree)
decision_rule.NO_VIOLATION_FOUND: every restart in the cell has excess <= 1e-7 (not a proof; finite search power, reported as best excess = distance below L1, number of restarts, budget)
decision_rule.cell_stop: a cell with VIOLATION_CERTIFIED is not extended

controls.positive_and_negative: scripts/openai_math/lt_matrix/controls.py rerun once at lane start, written to LT_A/controls.json (C1 exact equality potential reproduces L1; C2/C3 unitary invariance and additivity; C4 scalar search reaches L1 and not above; C6 gamma=3/2 not exceeded; NEGATIVE C5, C7: at gamma=3 the search must exceed the one-state constant for m=1 and m=2). Expected from the earlier pass (results/openai_math/hypotheses/lt_matrix/controls.json): all pass. If any fails: lane VOID.
controls.pre_reg_note: controls are rerun in this lane so its cells are tied to its own control pass; the earlier pass is not substituted

campaign_design.base_cells: gamma in {0.75, 1.0, 1.25, 1.4} x family in {random, embed, rotpair, twist}; m = 2, K = 2, P = 8; >= 12 restarts per cell
campaign_design.extra_cells: family random with K = 3, P = 10 at each of the four gammas; >= 12 restarts per cell
campaign_design.grid: M = 320 for gamma = 0.75, M = 160 otherwise; L = 24; Q = 1200 (M <= 200) or 2400 (frozen campaign.py rule)
campaign_design.seeds: from 1000 upward, allocated by append-only seed_ledger.json in blocks of 40 per chunk (name recorded); never reused
campaign_design.chunks: one driver call = at most 2 concurrent campaign.py processes, --threads 2 each (4 cores), --budget-s 420 (360 for gamma 0.75, whose M=320 restarts are slower); a restart in flight when the budget expires finishes, hard subprocess timeout about 520 s total per call. Restarts counts are what the cell JSON records; chunks of the same cell are summed
campaign_design.autoresearch_loop: after each round, aggregate; choose the non-saturated cell with highest best excess (closest to 0 from below); change EXACTLY ONE factor (family, or K/P pair, or seed block, or gamma); keep the change if the best excess of the new cell exceeds the parent's best excess; log every row (kept or discarded) to lane_results.tsv with the columns of results/openai_math/hypotheses/results.tsv. A cell is saturated when two consecutive extra chunks raised its best R by < 1e-8. The metric and verdict rule are frozen. Seed-block changes are fresh blocks from the ledger, never a repeat.
campaign_design.statistics_disclosure: restart count per cell is not equal after the loop; reported per cell. Cherry-picking is limited because every chunk's rows are kept and all cells are listed.

budget.cpu: 2 concurrent processes x 2 threads = 4 of 8 cores; no GPU use (T4 reserved for LTM ingest and 05:05 retrain)
budget.time: controls about 6 min; base cells 16 x >= 12 restarts plus 4 K=3 cells at about 15-90 s per restart, run until the 06:30 UTC lane deadline passed by the workflow; stop earlier on VOID

frozen_references.results/openai_math/hypotheses/lt_matrix: read; instrument hashes match the three files above

deviations_from_frozen_instruments: none. The frozen files are used unmodified. Third-grid recheck (L=32, M=256, Q=3200) is a new additional reporting check in lt_a_driver.py, not a change to the verdict rule.

smoke_tests_disclosed.lt_a_driver.py: run with no lane controls.json: chunk refused with the VOID message (rc 3); aggregate and recheck on an empty cells directory printed an empty list. No campaign number, no excess value and no R value was produced or seen. The recheck path with real .pt files is untested until the first flagged restart; if it errors it is fixed in the open and the fix recorded in deviations.md.

open_design_questions: alpha-level of search power: nothing known about how many restarts reach within 1e-6 of L1 for rotpair/twist in m = 2; it is measured, not assumed

campaign.py stores .pt only for best-so-far restarts; a flagged non-best restart has no stored parameters and is reported NO_STORED_PARAMS in the recheck (in practice a flagged restart that exceeds the previous best is stored)
gamma = 0.75 with M = 320 may exceed 90 s per restart; the realized restarts count may be less than 12 per chunk and is then extended in further chunks
